The '''Minas Stinger''' was a concept model of Y-Engine [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that was used during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The [[Minas]] Y-Engine line was only released to a limited market, making them a collector's item, however as only a few Stingers ever made it to production, the Stinger is the rarest of the lot. It featured a supercharged turbine, improving the base speed above that of other speeders in this line.<ref name="Bundle" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Minas Stinger was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was added to the game in Game Update 7.7.1 as a reward for the Galactic Seasons 9 event.<ref name="update">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250730|text=Game Update 7.7.1 Livestream Recap}}</ref> In-game, the Minas Stinger allowed the player to travel as if they had achieved Speeder Piloting III, whilst only having Speeder Piloting I. Additionally, the max speed increased, resulting in a top speed of 130% compared to regular in-game mounts.<ref name="Bundle" />
